prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1300
Claimant:
Jason Walls
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
March 15, 2023
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and said the other vehicle drifted into the adjacent lane as they
moved over. The claimant reports a wrist fracture from the event and is not represented by an attorney.
March 19, 2023
Reviewed the initial statement from the claimant, which described the lane change and contact on the driver's side.
The account has stayed consistent across each conversation so far.
April 6, 2023
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the vehicles made contact during the merge and described the same
sequence of movements. Their account lines up with what the claimant has said.
April 29, 2023
Police report notes that the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene, and two witnesses gave statements that match
the described impact. Photos from the scene were added to the file.
May 17, 2023
Inspected the vehicle and the damage pattern on the driver's side fits the impact described by all parties. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior records or the claimant's disclosures.
June 28, 2023
Confirmed the policy coverage start date and found nothing indicating the damage predates it. The driver of the
vehicle lives with the policyholder and is listed as a household member under the policy.
July 19, 2023
Obtained initial medical records showing a wrist fracture. Whether this injury stems from the collision has not yet been
determined, and additional records are needed before a causation view can be formed.
July 31, 2023
Claimant's provider notes no prior injury to the same wrist or arm, and the claimant has not mentioned any earlier
problems with that area during any contact.
August 21, 2023
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of fracture. Requested updated treatment
notes and follow-up imaging to understand the recovery timeline.
September 6, 2023
Spoke with the claimant again by phone. The claimant repeated the same account of the lane change and the
contact, with no changes in sequence or detail from earlier conversations.
September 18, 2023
Reviewed the photos and witness statements together and they support the reported impact and the vehicle damage.
Nothing in the file currently points to a different sequence of events.
September 28, 2023
Open items remain the medical causation review and the updated treatment records. Will follow up with the treating
provider and reassess once those documents are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
